about: Deaths by cause and age band, the shares a death is assigned from. Each cause's share of all deaths in its age band is deaths over all deaths in the band; the shares are linear between band midpoints so no age is a cliff, and the rest is 'other'. A band the source does not report has zero deaths.
refreshNote: The outcome web's factor on a cause multiplies that cause's share (see src/core2/death-cause.ts).

source.citation: NCHS Data Brief No. 521, Mortality in the United States, 2023, Table 3 (deaths by age group) and Table 5 (infant deaths). Total 3,090,964 deaths in 2023.

NCHS Data Brief No. 522, Drug Overdose Deaths in the United States, 2003-2023, Table 2 and Figure 2: drug overdose deaths 2023 by age group (105,007 in all). The brief reports no row under age 15, so that band holds zero.

Age spread: CDC QuickStats supplementary table, Percentage of Suicides and Homicides Involving a Firearm Among Persons Aged 10 Years and Over, by Age Group, United States, 2022 (stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/160513), firearm homicide deaths 6,114; 9,697; 3,027; 625 (ICD-10 U01.4, X93-X95), nothing reported under age 10. Level: NCHS Data Brief No. 526, Trends in Death Rates for Leading Methods of Injury, 2003-2023, Table 4: 17,927 firearm homicides in 2023. The 2022 counts are scaled to the 2023 total.
source.estimatedFrom: 2022 age counts scaled to the 2023 national total; spread the size of the year-to-year change in the total (2022 19,463 to 2023 17,927)

Level: NCHS Data Brief No. 526, Table 3: 27,300 firearm suicides in 2023. The 2022 counts are scaled to the 2023 total.
